link.name: link
link.description: Link this Discord account with the code from the platform

code.name: code
code.description: The code from the Connections page, for example ABCD-EFGH

unlink.name: unlink
unlink.description: Remove the link between this Discord account and the platform

status.name: status
status.description: Show the link and whether runs are switched on

language.name: language
language.description: Choose the language of the bot's replies

help.name: help
help.description: Show what the bot can do

ask.name: ask
ask.description: Ask the Chief of Staff or one of your workflows

agent.name: agent
agent.description: The name of one of your workflows (optional)

replies.help:
Commands in this direct message:
/link code: link this Discord account with the code from the Connections page on the platform.
/unlink: remove the link.
/status: show the link and whether runs are switched on.
/language: choose the language of these replies.
/ask: ask the Chief of Staff (not available yet).
replies.notAvailable: The chat channel is not available right now.
replies.useDirectMessage: Use these commands in a direct message with the bot.
replies.unknownCommand: Unknown command. Use /help to see the commands.
replies.error: Something went wrong. Try again later.
replies.linkFirst: This Discord account is not linked. Make a code on the Connections page on the platform, then use /link here.
replies.notEntitled: This account cannot use the chat channel.

link.claimed: Code accepted. Go back to the Connections page on the platform and press Confirm to finish linking.
link.invalid: That code did not work. Make a new code on the Connections page and try again.
link.alreadyLinked: This Discord account is already linked. Use /unlink first to link it to another account.
link.paused: Linking is paused for now. Try again later.

unlink.done: The link is removed. This Discord account no longer receives anything from the platform.

ask.runsOff: Runs are switched off on the platform. Nothing was started.
ask.notBuilt: Asking from Discord is not available yet. Nothing was started.
